## A test of citation reading Introduction

Rare disease diagnosis still fails for most patients. 1 Population databases shape how variants are read. 2 Genome sequencing in a national health system raised the yield. 3 Deep learning has changed many fields. 4 Protein structure can now be predicted. 5 Short reads are aligned with fast index methods. 6 Gapped alignment scales to large genomes. 7 Count data need their own statistical models. 8
